item.title: Stock markets tumble in early trade on Middle East conflict, foreign fund outflows

item.title: Joint Pain in Young Adults – A Growing Concern
item.description: Joint pain was traditionally associated with ageing. However, an increasing number of young adults now report persistent joint discomfort, stiffness, and reduced mobility. Sedentary work patterns, high-intensity physical activity, and inflammatory conditions contribute significantly to this trend. Young professionals in urban environments often spend long hours sitting, commuting, or using digital devices. Consequently, joint structures [...]
